API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPolicy ManagementGets paginated policy rules for the specified policy type.
Gets paginated policy rules for the specified policy type.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/rules/policyType/:policyType

Gets paginated policy rules for the specified policy type.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

policyType
string
REQUIRED

Type for differentiating policy types. Supported values : ACCESS_POLICY/GLOBAL_POLICY, TIMEOUT_POLICY/REAUTH_POLICY, SIEM_POLICY, CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY/BYPASS_POLICY, INSPECTION_POLICY, CREDENTIAL_POLICY, CAPABILITIES_POLICY, ISOLATION_POLICY, CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY,REDIRECTION_POLICY, PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. Default value is 0 and get data from Default microtenant.

Default value: 0
Responses
​

400
401
403
404
405

415

OK

Example (auto)
